Results.ReviewText: Super convenient, perfect for quick cooks.  I use it a lot more than I originally thought I would.  A great addition to my Weber arsenal.
Results.Title: Fabulous little grill.

Results.ReviewText: Pizza, lahmajun, shish kabob, steak, burger.. Whatever you throw at it, it cooks perfectly. I have absolutely nothing to complain
Results.Title: Nothing to complain

Results.ReviewText:
Seems to run a bit hot. Obvious temperature variation side x side and front x back.
Learning which is which for best cooking experience.
Results.Title: My grill before a grill.

Results.ReviewText: An excellent grill with a great design. Easy to keep clean. Looks great on our patio.
Results.Title: Wish I had this years ago

Results.ReviewText: I love how fast this grill reaches 400 degrees. However I had trouble keeping it lower. The construction of this grill is superior. It will definitely last longer than the grills we have purchase before.
Results.Title: Learning to control the heat

Results.ReviewText: I am very pleased with this grill. The cooking time seems to be a lot shorter than my old larger grill. Also cleaning the grates is very easy.
Results.Title: GLG (Great Little Grill)

Results.ReviewText: I cannot express how much we love this tabletop grill!  It heats up to temp in a flash. It’s perfect for a couple or a small family. I seasoned the grates before the first use, and never have an issue with sticking or clean up.  I could not, no I would not live without my Weber Q grill. In this day of cheap quality, &  throw away products, it’s refreshing to know if I buy Weber, I’m always going to get a great product made to last and will always have great customer service to back it up!!  Thank you for being and staying a company that values quality and customer care!!!
Results.Title: Weber Q 1200 Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: After using other grills for a while I came back to Webber. I forgot how easy this BBQ was to use and how well it cooks. Glad to be back.
Results.Title: Great Barbeque

Results.ReviewText: Grilled a pork tenderloin today and it turned out a little too charred and dry. With only one burner , you can not grill indirectly with meat off to the side. Will have to adjust method next time. Burgers turned out great last week.
Results.Title: Mixed results.

Results.ReviewText: I've been very impressed with this little grill. It's worked out great for travel, and it's perfect for quick meals at home for 1-2 people.
Results.Title: Great small grill!

Results.ReviewText: Awesome little grill! Upgraded from grill that came with camper to the Q 1200. Was easy to figure out the combination to cooking steaks and burgers. Uses very little propane, hits searing temps pretty quickly. Had opportunity to cook on a larger version some years ago, and was impressed with the performance, so made sense to look at the Q series for the camper.
Results.Title: Awesome camper grill upgrade!

Results.ReviewText: Perfect for camping. Very easy clean up too!……………….
Results.Title: Weber Q 1200 Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: Bought this specifically to use for tailgating to football games. Fits perfectly with the stand into my Mazda CX-9 2017 rear cargo area. Can set it up and have it running in about three minutes. Well thought out design. Seems sturdy and should last a long time as well.  Purchased the special made small tongs and spatula which work perfectly with the hanging hooks. Love the fold out trays for food prep. I use this to support 2-4 fans for dogs, burgers and sausage.  Because its so small and portable, I only bought the smaller cover as I carry and store this in my basement. Only one, very minor negative; it can be tricky to get the small gas canister screwed in. Usually takes an extra 1-2 minutes. From popping my rear hatch to take out the grill, to heat of 400', to cool down and back in the car for September and October games is less then one hour.
Results.Title: Shocked how perfect this grill is for my needs

Results.ReviewText: We were replacing an older model that we have had for many years.  We are rv people so need to have a good quality, size is very important in our storage space, and its does such a great job!
Results.Title: Great BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, heats up quickly and is the perfect size for 2 people. My only qualm was that the regulator broke after 2 months use. However, Weber quickly replaced it hassle-free and I’m back to grilling
Results.Title: Nice Little Grill

Results.ReviewText: Grill has been great for 2 of us while camping. Solid quality as always with Weber. My only complaint is when using a 1lb propane bottle, it’s very frustrating trying to get it to thread on. The frame gets in the way of the bottle.
Results.Title: Only one complaint

Results.ReviewText: Needed a small grill to be good quality, fill in for camping that could be compact and fit in my camper. After buying and then returning a competitors model twice, my buddy said he had used almost this same model for 6 or so years and loved it. Although there were a few design changes from his. They were subtle improvements I feel for the better. This little Weber 1200 regulates the heat way better than the one I had to return. The grills are great quality. I’m very happy with this little unit.
Results.Title: Great little grill !

Results.ReviewText:
Love this grill. Portable. Heats up fast. Cooks evenly. Cleans quickly. 
Great option for burgers and dogs for 8-10 people. Good option for steak for 4 people.
So far have not needed the stand, but may purchase.
I did purchase the adapter hose to use with 15gallon propane tanks.
Results.Title: Portable grilling at its best

Results.ReviewText: Only recommendation I would respectfully submit is the battery operated igniter falls out pretty easily during transport… Almost lost it twice. So I now keep it separate & install once needed. Inconvenient but at least I know where it is…
Results.Title: Q1200

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We apologize for the inconvenience you are experiencing. If your grill is not getting hot enough, then something is not right! Your grill should easily reach 500 F which is hot enough to sear. Our Support team would like to know more and offer our assistance. Please look for an email outreach from us soon.

If you are using an adapter hose and full-sized tank with your grill, the following steps may help:
· Make sure the control knob is in the off position.
· Open the grill lid.
· Open the valve on the propane tank all the way, and then wait for about 60 seconds.
· Turn the control knob to START/HIGH and press the igniter button.
· Once the burner is lit, close the lid and in 10 to 15 minutes the grill should reach 500 to 550F.
· Always make sure to turn the control knob to OFF after you are done using the grill.

Please look for our email outreach. We look forward to helping you soon!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: The unit dose not give enough heat to cook well when trying to grill
Results.Title: Weber 1200

Results.ReviewText: Cleaver design and well made of good materials. Easy to fold up and store. Easy to ignite the burner and to control the temperature. It heats up quickly. Easy to clean. It will last through generations. Another Webber Classic just like their ubiquitous, seen everywhere, charcoal grills. Perfect.
Results.Title: An excellent compact gas grill

Results.ReviewText: I’ve owned much larger Weber grills but have been very impressed with my Q1200. I use it when in the RV and could use it at home as well. The shelves that fold out are very handy when grilling but do not get in the way when I travel. The cast iron grills are very impressive and produce excellent results. This is a great grill and worth considering if you are in the market for a grill. It may look compact but it certainly handles all my needs.
Results.Title: Great for the RV and home

Results.ReviewText: Awesome grill!! Works very efficiently. Perfect for car camping, tailgating or grilling for that especial someone. I highly recommend it.
Results.Title: Best Grill on the market

Results.ReviewText: Great product works great  good company you can’t go wrong with this grill
Results.Title: Weber q1200

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! Thank you for being a long time Weber fan! We greatly appreciate your feedback regarding the regulator on the Q1200 grill. We are so sorry to learn your regulator went out. Our team has reached out via email to discuss this further to see if your part is still under warranty. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Gas regulator worked for several times then needed replaced. Very pricey part compared to other grills.
Results.Title: Gas regulator defective.

Results.ReviewText: Excellent for tailgating… relatively lightweight, portable for ease in transporting, and grills well.
Results.Title: Weber Q 1200 Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: How well you stand behind the integrity of your products and are willing to replace faulty parts when they malfunction.  Thanks for your cooperation.
Results.Title: Warranty support

Results.ReviewText: greatest small gas grill ever, 2nd one to own first one lasted a good 10 years
Results.Title: proud owner

Results.ReviewText: Good quality, easy to assemble. Very compact. A typical Weber product
Results.Title: Great for an apartment

Results.ReviewText: I love my grill. Heats quickly and I've used it for all sorts of meats and even roasting hatch chiles. Only mild complaint is putting the canister on can be a little harder than it needs to be because of the placement and angle. Other than that it's been great.
Results.Title: Great little grill

Results.ReviewText: This is the gold standard for small, portable grills. Lights easy, maintains even heat, cleans up for storage. It was a hit right out of the box.
Results.Title: Perfect traveller's grill

Results.ReviewText: Great portable grill!  Easy to operate, grills well, easy to clean.
Results.Title: Perfect for two people-quality product!

Results.ReviewText: Great quality.  I like it because its not so big and is perfect  for camping. I used at home and when I go camping.  All the bbq which I made on this grill come out very tasty and well cooked.  I regret i didn't buy it earlier and not wasted my money on other bbq which doesn't do a great job like this one.  I am very happy with the purchase. The only think which i wish will come with it its an accessory to be able to connect to bigger gas tank.
Results.Title: Great quality gas grill

Results.ReviewText: A great portable grill option for tailgating or other mobile grilling events.  Easy to assemble, transport , and store. It works just like a mini-Weber. Good quality, heats up quickly, and cooks efficiently. I would strongly recommend this grill.
Results.Title: A solid tailgate selection for all seasons.

Results.ReviewText: We LOVE our grille. We made the mistake of buying a non Weber earlier in the year and was very unhappy. You get what you pay for. Quality and Performance!
Results.Title: LOVE our Weber

Results.ReviewText: It’s small and compact. It’s perfect for our camping trips. We have cooked burgers and hotdogs for five people on it, so it’s a great size.
Results.Title: Great little grill

Results.ReviewText: No issues with the grill, size is good enough for two. Heated up good and kept a constant temperature during cook time. Light weight, easy to stow. The issue I had is I purchased the portable stand for it. First its a little flimsy. The first time I used it, when I was folding it up, the PLASTIC locking hook on the stand broke. Not sure how but it went flying when I folded it up. I called Weber for the warranty after 3 different parts were sent, I finally received the right one. Only because I had the person I was talking to send me a copy of the parts breakdown while I was on the phone and figured out what I needed even after sending multiple pictures. Over all customer service was good because Weber did honor the warranty, took awhile but was taken care of. Quality of the stand could be better with some metal parts.
Results.Title: Good grill, not so good stand
